낮에 보이는 이동 가능한 땅에 심습니다. 낮 18초 동안 자라며 밤에는: Plant it on open, walkable ground by day. It grows for 18 seconds of daytime, and at night it attacks and holds nearby foes. If not fully grown, its attack is halved. If it survives, it stays for the next day, and up to 4 can be grown at once. Offer Black Wool to fully grow it at once, raise its max health and attack, and restore all its health.
낮에 목장의 빈자리에 검은 양 한 마리를 들입니다. 다음 날부터 매일 검: By day, bring one black sheep into an empty spot in the pasture. From the next day, black wool grows daily; click to shear it like a normal sheep and gain 1 Black Wool card. Only one unharvested portion is kept. Black Wool can be offered to a planted thorn barricade to strengthen and heal it.
검은 양에게서 수확한 공물입니다. 낮이나 밤 전투 중에 가시 씨앗 또는: A tribute harvested from a black sheep. Place it on a Thorn Seed or thorn barricade, by day or during night combat, to consume 1. It instantly grows fully, with max health 130 and attack 10, and restores all health. A strengthened barricade can be offered to again to heal when damaged. If it is already strengthened and at full health, nothing is consumed.
생산 준비가 된 양에게 마녀가 다가가 수확한 재료입니다. 같은 양털은 카: Material the Witch gathers by approaching a sheep that is ready to produce. Identical wool stacks on one card by quantity, shown at the card's lower left. Place it at the Lodge to sell 1 at a time instantly.
용병의 벌목이 끝나거나 숲의 괴물 하수인이 시들면 얻는 재료입니다. 같은: Material gained when a Mercenary finishes logging or a forest monster minion withers. Identical timber stacks on one card by quantity. Place it at the Lodge to repair with 1. Building, expanding, and enlarging structures and restoring the Altar take several timber from your hand.
덩치가 크고 등에 가지가 돋은 큰 숲의 괴물을 처치하면 얻습니다. 적이나: Gained by slaying a big forest monster with branches sprouting from its back. Use it on a foe or valid ground to summon an allied minion, consuming the card. The minion withers when it falls or when day comes, becoming 1 Timber.
마녀가 눈밭에 새기는 달 룬입니다. 밤 전투 중에 적이나 지면에 사용하면: A moon rune the Witch carves in the snow. Use it on a foe or the ground during night combat to burst on the spot, damaging nearby foes and briefly slowing their movement. Consumes the card.
굽은 장대에 매단 마녀의 등불입니다. 지면에 설치하면 주변 안개를 걷어: A Witch's lantern hung on a bent pole. Set on the ground, it clears nearby Fog, and foes that enter its light are slowed. If set up beforehand by day, it stays lit until that night's combat ends. There is a limit to how many can be lit at once.
산장 문장으로 봉인한 초대장입니다. 준비 시간에 산장에 사용하면 손님 한: An invitation sealed with the Lodge crest. Use it at the Lodge during preparation time and a party of Guests arrives at once, stays, and pays for lodging. One of them can be hired as a Mercenary. There must be time left for the Guests to stay.
목장에 사용하면 새끼양 한 마리가 들어옵니다. 새끼양은 털을 생산하지 않: Use it on the pasture to bring in one lamb. A lamb produces no wool and has low health. When day comes two days after arriving, it grows into an adult sheep and can be sheared right away. The pasture must have an empty spot.
숙박한 손님을 고용해 얻은 벌목 계약입니다. 벌목 가능한 나무에 사용하면: A logging contract gained by hiring a lodging Guest. Use it on a choppable tree to fell it completely; when it is done, the Lumberjack moves to the nearest next tree. He carries the felled timber himself and hands it over when the Witch approaches. At night he shelters inside the Lodge.
숙박한 손님을 고용해 얻은 사냥 계약입니다. 낮에는 숲을 돌아다니는 토끼: A hunting contract gained by hiring a lodging Guest. By day he shoots rabbits and deer roaming the forest with a bow, collects raw meat and pelts, and hands them over when the Witch approaches. When foes come, he shoots arrows from afar, and when there are none he scouts around the Lodge.
숙박한 손님을 고용해 얻은 전투 계약입니다. 산장 주변을 정찰하다 적이: A combat contract gained by hiring a lodging Guest. He scouts around the Lodge, and when he spots a foe he charges in for close combat. If the Lodge is attacked, he goes after the attacker first.
숙박한 손님을 고용해 얻은 채집 계약입니다. 낮에 숲의 랜드마크를 돌며: A foraging contract gained by hiring a lodging Guest. By day she tours the forest's landmarks picking up timber, raw meat, and pelts, and rarely finds a treasure chest, returning before evening. After she returns, she hands items over when the Witch approaches. At night she shelters inside the Lodge.
사냥꾼이 잡은 토끼·사슴과 채집가가 가져온 고기입니다. 같은 생고기는 카: Meat from rabbits and deer caught by the Hunter, and meat brought back by the Gatherer. Identical raw meat stacks on one card by quantity. Place it at the Lodge to sell 1 at a time instantly, or place it on the Witch to eat a portion and restore health.
앞마당 모닥불이 켜져 있을 때 생고기를 놓아 끓인 스튜입니다. 다친 용병: A stew simmered by placing raw meat on the front-yard Campfire while it is lit. Place it on a wounded Mercenary to restore 80% of max health. Usable by day and by night.
토끼를 사냥하면 생고기 대신 나오기도 하는 가죽입니다. 같은 가죽은 카드: A pelt that sometimes drops instead of raw meat when hunting rabbits. Identical pelts stack on one card by quantity. Place it at the Lodge to sell 1 at a time instantly.
채집가가 숲에서 찾아온 낡은 상자입니다. 지면에 놓으면 상자가 열리며 물: A worn chest the Gatherer found in the forest. Set it on the ground and the chest opens, revealing three question-mark cards; choose one to gain a Relic. Relics are permanent passives shown in the relic slots at the upper left.
An unrevealed Relic that comes out of a Treasure Chest face down.
밤에도 산장 8m 안의 아군이 초당 1 회복하고, 매일 낮 시작에 산장: Even at night, allies within 8m of the Lodge recover 1 per second, and at the start of each day the Lodge recovers 40 health.
벌목 1회 시간이 15초에서 10초로 줄고, 벌목 1회 목재가 50% 늘: Each logging takes 10 seconds instead of 15, and each logging yields 50% more timber.
Hunters and Sellswords deal +40% damage, and game yields 1 extra resource.
모든 적의 이동 속도가 85%가 되고, 매일 낮 시작에 서리 룬 카드 1: All foes' movement speed becomes 85%, and at the start of each day you receive 1 Frost Rune card.
마녀에게 놓으면 체력을 치르고 마녀의 주머니에서 무작위로 카드 한 장을: Place it on the Witch to pay health and bring a random card from the Witch's pouch into your hand. If her health is at or below the cost, she cannot eat it. If the pouch is empty, it cannot be used and costs nothing. A used Poison Mushroom goes to the discard pile.
어디에 놓아도 됩니다. 마녀의 주머니에 실제로 있는 카드 중 최대 세 장: Can be placed anywhere. Reveals up to three random cards actually in the Witch's pouch, and when you choose one, a copy of it comes to your hand (1 for stacked resources). If the pouch holds only one or two cards, it shows what there is. All revealed cards, including the original you chose, stay in the pouch, and time stops while you choose. If the pouch is empty, it cannot be used and costs nothing.
숲의 이끼로 감은 붕대입니다. 마녀에게 사용하면 체력을 조금 회복하고,: A bandage wrapped with forest moss. Use it on the Witch to restore a little health and remove one Blight card from your hand (or the pouch if none in hand).
송진을 먹인 횃불입니다. 밤 전투 중 땅이나 적에게 사용하면 그 자리에: A torch soaked in pine resin. Use it on the ground or a foe during night combat and flames remain there for a few seconds, damaging foes in the area every second.
유리병에 모아 둔 반딧불이입니다. 땅에 풀면 넓은 범위의 안개를 걷어 냅: Fireflies gathered in a glass jar. Release them on the ground to clear Fog over a wide area. Especially useful on foggy nights.
숲 바닥의 덩굴을 깨워 묶는 덫입니다. 밤 전투 중 사용하면 범위 안의: A trap that wakes the vines of the forest floor to bind foes. Use it during night combat to damage foes in the area and leave them nearly unable to move for a few seconds.
겨울을 나려고 쌓아 둔 단단한 장작입니다. 산장에 사용하면 체력을 회복합: Hard firewood stacked to see out the winter. Use it on the Lodge to restore health. Unlike timber repair, it can be used during night combat too.
제단에서 처음 수의의 의식을 완성하면 얻는 권능입니다. 사용한 날 밤 동: A power gained by completing the Shroud Ritual at the Altar for the first time. For the night it is used, the Witch and her allies endure one hit that would fell them, staying at 1 health.
제단에서 처음 가시의 봉헌을 완성하면 얻는 권능입니다. 밤 전투 중 사용: A power gained by completing the Thorn Offering at the Altar for the first time. Use it during night combat to damage foes over a wide area and bind them with thorns until they are nearly stopped.
제단에서 처음 붉은 만찬을 완성하면 얻는 권능입니다. 사용한 날 밤 동안: A power gained by completing the Crimson Feast at the Altar for the first time. For the night it is used, the Witch heals by a portion of the damage her magic bolts deal.
고대 존재에게 깨워진 거대 짐승, 빈 굴의 주인을 쓰러뜨리면 얻는 전리품: Spoils gained by defeating the Master of the Empty Den, a giant beast awakened by an ancient being. Use it on the Lodge to halve the damage the Lodge takes that night.
보스 · 빈 굴의 주인 처치: Boss · Defeat the Master of the Empty Den
침식된 자가 산장 벽에 새긴 기도문이 주머니에 스며든 것입니다. 쓸 수: A prayer carved on the Lodge wall by a corrupted one, seeped into the pouch. It cannot be used and only takes up hand space. Remove it with a Moss Bandage or market-day cleansing.
침식된 자가 산장을 공격: A corrupted one attacks the Lodge
맹독 곤충이 남긴 포자입니다. 쓸 수 없고, 손패에 있으면 새벽마다 마녀: Spores left by a venomous insect. It cannot be used, and while in hand it drains a little of the Witch's health each dawn (never fatally). Remove it by cleansing.
맹독 곤충이 마녀를 공격: A venomous insect attacks the Witch
보스의 울부짖음이 남긴 저주입니다. 쓸 수 없고, 손패에 있으면 그날 아: A curse left by the boss's roar. It cannot be used, and while in hand you cannot draw that morning. Remove it by cleansing.
늑대 수인 파르그가 검은 양 한 마리의 값으로 건넨 피입니다. 낮이든 밤: Blood handed over by the werewolf Parg in exchange for one black sheep. Place it on the Witch, by day or night, and after she suffers briefly, three cards, Crescent Moon, Half Moon, and Full Moon, enter the pouch. Moon cards are used on the Witch at night; only one per night, and each only once.
파르그의 대화 이벤트(검은 양 수락): Parg's dialogue event (accept the black sheep)
Place it on the Witch during night combat. For that night, the interval between magic bolts shortens. Only one moon card can be used per night, and the used card vanishes.
밤 전투 중 마녀에게 놓습니다. 그 밤 동안 마법탄 간격이 짧아지고 이동: Place it on the Witch during night combat. For that night, the interval between magic bolts shortens and movement speed rises. Only one moon card can be used per night, and the used card vanishes.
밤 전투 중 마녀에게 놓습니다. 그 밤이 끝날 때까지 늑대가 되어 빠르게: Place it on the Witch during night combat. Until the night ends she becomes a wolf, running fast and biting nearby foes with her fangs. Q slashes the front arc four times hard, and E pounces on a foe a little way off and mauls it. Cards cannot be used while a wolf. She returns to a Witch at dawn, and the card vanishes.
오래된 국경 수비대의 장검입니다. 용병에게 끌어 놓으면 무기 칸에 끼워: A longsword of an old border garrison. Drag it onto a Mercenary to fit it in the weapon slot and increase damage by 30%. The Witch cannot use it.
시험 지급(카드 컨셉 확정 전): Trial issue (before the card concept is finalized)
벼락 맞은 참나무 가지로 깎은 지팡이입니다. 마녀에게 끌어 놓으면 무기: A staff carved from a lightning-struck oak branch. Drag it onto the Witch to fit it in the weapon slot and increase magic bolt damage by 25%.
양털을 겹겹이 누빈 솜옷입니다. 마녀나 용병의 방어구 칸에 끼우면 최대: A padded jacket quilted with layers of wool. Fit in a Witch's or Mercenary's armor slot for max health +15 and damage taken -15%.
먼 길을 걸어온 나그네가 두고 간 장화입니다. 장신구 칸에 끼우면 이동: Boots left behind by a traveler from afar. Fit in a trinket slot for movement speed +15%.
붉은 마가목 열매를 꿴 부적입니다. 장신구 칸에 끼우면 초당 체력 0.4: A charm strung with red rowan berries. Fit in a trinket slot to recover 0.4 health per second.
고블린 그라즈의 사촌과 그 친구들입니다. 밤 전투 중 땅이나 적에게 놓으: Goblin Graz's cousins and their friends. Place it on the ground or a foe during night combat to call 3 Goblin Lackeys. With 2 or more Goblin Mercenaries, 4 come. Lackeys are weak but rush at nearby foes, and return to the forest when the night ends.
고블린 타크의 주머니에서 나온 수상한 통입니다. 밤 전투 중 땅이나 적에: A suspicious canister from Goblin Tak's pocket. Throw it on the ground or a foe during night combat to burst widely and deal damage; struck foes flinch back in fear. There is a 15% chance allies in range are lightly hurt too. With 4 or more Goblin Mercenaries, you gain 2 Dud Bombs after using it.
고블린 폭죽 가운데 제대로 안 터진 녀석입니다. 밤 전투 중 땅이나 적에: One of the Goblin Firecrackers that didn't go off properly. Throw it on the ground or a foe during night combat to deal low damage to foes in a small area and stun them for 2 seconds.
고블린 폭죽 사용(고블린 용병 4명 이상): Using a Goblin Firecracker (4 or more Goblin Mercenaries)
고블린 피클이 셈을 포기하고 생각해 낸 작전입니다. 밤 전투 중 땅이나: A plan Goblin Pikl came up with after giving up on counting. Place it on the ground or a foe during night combat and all current Goblin Lackeys charge there, dealing damage proportional to their number. Cannot be used if there are no Lackeys.
유리구슬과 동전을 잔뜩 붙인 미끼입니다. 밤 전투 중 땅에 던지면 8초: A lure covered in glass beads and coins. Throw it on the ground during night combat and for 8 seconds nearby foes swarm to the lure instead of the Lodge. When time ends it bursts, dazzling nearby foes for 2 seconds. Damage Goblin Lackeys deal to foes near the lure increases by 50%.
고블린 러스크가 고물로 세우는 허술한 방책입니다. 땅에 놓고 손패의 목재: A shoddy barricade Goblin Rusk builds from junk. Place it on the ground and use 1 timber from your hand to raise it at once. Its health is a low 40, but nearby foes strike it before the Lodge. It collapses by itself at dawn 2 days later.
고블린 사냥꾼 피클의 덫 세 개입니다. 땅에 놓으면 둘레에 덫을 깔고,: Three traps from Goblin hunter Pikl. Place it on the ground to lay traps around it; foes who step on them take damage and halt briefly. If you have a Goblin Mercenary, sprung traps are reset every dawn.
고블린 타크가 주머니를 정리하며 넘겨준 자루입니다. 낮에 아무 곳에나 놓: A sack Goblin Tak handed over while tidying his pockets. Place it anywhere by day to open it and get 2 to 4 of Timber, Raw Meat, Pelts, and Wool, with scrap metal mixed in now and then.
잡동사니 자루에서 나온 녹슨 쇠붙이입니다. 산장에 놓으면 1개 4G에 팝: Rusty scrap metal from a Junk Sack. Place it at the Lodge to sell for 4G each.
그라즈 할아버지의 호루라기입니다. 용병의 장신구 칸에 끼웁니다. 고블린: Grandpa Graz's whistle. Fit in a Mercenary's trinket slot. If a Goblin Mercenary wears it, it calls 1 Goblin Lackey every 20 seconds during the night, and up to 3 whistle Lackeys stay with him.
냄비를 펴서 만든 투구입니다. 용병의 방어구 칸에 끼우면 받는 피해 5회: A helmet made by flattening a pot. Fit in a Mercenary's armor slot to block 5 hits in turn by 100%, 80%, 60%, 40%, and 20%, and it breaks on the 6th hit. When a Goblin wears it, it doesn't break and holds at 10%, and at daybreak it is mended and blocks from 100% again.
골동품 수집가 말라의 작은 저울입니다. 용병의 장신구 칸에 끼우면 그 용: A small scale belonging to Mala, an antique collector. Fit in a Mercenary's trinket slot to increase the Gold dropped when that Mercenary defeats a foe by 1.
말라의 이야기 '값을 매기는 눈' — 금화를 센다: Mala's treasured monocle. Fit in a Mercenary's trinket slot to make the chance of goods dropping from foes that Mercenary defeats 1.5 times higher.
말라가 아끼던 외알 안경입니다. 용병의 장신구 칸에 끼우면 그 용병이 쓰: Mala's story 'The Appraising Eye': count the gold coins
말라의 이야기 '값을 매기는 눈' — 물건을 본다: Mala's story 'The Appraising Eye': examine the goods
요정이 장난삼아 물건을 바꿔치기하는 솜씨입니다. 낮이든 밤이든 아무 곳에: A fairy's knack for swapping things as a prank. Place it anywhere, by day or night, and discard 1 card from your hand to receive 1 random race card of a different type from it. There is a 10% chance a Blight card comes instead.
잠결에 숲의 꿈을 받아 적은 요정의 기록장입니다. 마녀의 장신구 칸에 끼: A journal in which a fairy wrote down forest dreams received in her sleep. Fit in the Witch's trinket slot to look at 2 cards from the pouch during the morning draw and choose 1 of them to receive.
엉겅퀴 가시를 엮어 맹세의 표로 삼은 장신구입니다. 용병의 장신구 칸에: A trinket woven from thistle thorns as a token of an oath. Fit in a Mercenary's trinket slot and foes hit by that Mercenary's attacks have their movement speed slowed by 40% for 2.5 seconds.
요정 용병이 숲을 아껴 달라고 청하는 대화 이벤트입니다. 약속한다: 요정: A dialogue event where a Fairy Mercenary asks you to look after the forest. Promise: receive 2 Fairy cards, and you cannot log for a day, starting tomorrow. Refuse: no Fairy events appear for a day. A codex and record card that does not enter your hand.
자루에 조상의 룬을 새긴 드워프 망치입니다. 용병의 무기 칸에 끼우면 새: A Dwarf hammer with ancestral runes carved on its handle. Fit in a Mercenary's weapon slot and each dawn it uses 1 timber from your hand to repair the most damaged of the Lodge, barricade, or wall by 40 health. Held by a Dwarf Mercenary, it repairs 80.
드워프가 산을 넘으며 메고 다니는 진한 흑맥주입니다. 아무 곳에나 놓으면: Strong dark ale Dwarves carry across the mountains. Place it anywhere and for that night (until dawn) all Mercenaries' max health rises 30% and movement speed slows 15%. Dwarf Mercenaries are not slowed.
드워프 석공이 놓는 성벽의 기초입니다. 땅에 놓으면 체력 220의 돌벽이: The footing of a wall laid by a Dwarf stonemason. Place it on the ground to raise a stone wall with 220 health, and nearby foes strike the stone wall before the Lodge. It stays until it breaks. With 3 or more Dwarves, it repairs 30 health by itself each dawn.
대대로 물려 온 드워프의 둥근 방패입니다. 용병의 방어구 칸에 끼우면 받: A Dwarf's round shield passed down through generations. Fit in a Mercenary's armor slot to reduce damage taken by 30%. Held by a Dwarf Mercenary, allies within 4m also take 15% less damage.
갱도를 받치던 굵은 버팀목입니다. 산장 가까운 땅에 세우면 서 있는 동안: A thick prop that held up the mine shaft. Set it in the ground near the Lodge and while it stands, the Lodge's max health rises by 60. When it breaks, it collapses and deals 45 damage to foes within 3.5m.
드워프가 돌에게 불러 주는 낮은 노래입니다. 밤 전투 중 아무 곳에나 놓: A low song Dwarves sing to the stone. Place it anywhere during night combat and for 5 seconds all structures, including the Lodge, Watchtower, barricades, and walls, take no damage. With 4 or more Dwarves, it lasts 10 seconds.
가죽을 메운 오크의 전쟁 북입니다. 아무 곳에나 놓으면 그 밤(새벽까지): An Orc's war drum covered in hide. Place it anywhere and for that night (until dawn) all Mercenaries' attack rises 30%. Orc Mercenaries gain 60% and knock foes back with every hit.
솥째 나눠 먹자는 오크의 잔칫상입니다. 아무 곳에나 놓으면 고기 스튜 2: An Orc feast table, to be shared straight from the pot. Place it anywhere and 2 Meat Stews come to your hand. With 3 or more Orcs, 1 more comes.
뼈에 피로 새기는 오크의 맹세입니다. 오크 용병에게 놓으면 그 용병의 최: An Orc oath carved in blood on bone. Place it on an Orc Mercenary to permanently raise that Mercenary's max health by 50% and attack by 30%. In return, that Mercenary can neither be released from contract nor offered as a sacrifice.
오크 용병이 뼈를 던져 오늘 밤을 점치는 대화 이벤트입니다. 오늘 밤 적: A dialogue event where an Orc Mercenary throws bones to divine tonight. Reveals tonight's enemy makeup. Prepare: receive 1 preparation card. Accept fate: Gold from foes slain tonight is doubled. A codex and record card that does not enter your hand.
적을 쓰러뜨릴 때마다 터져 나오는 오크의 함성입니다. 밤 전투 중 아무: The Orc war cry that bursts out whenever a foe falls. Place it anywhere during night combat and each time you defeat a foe that night, Orc Mercenaries' attack speed rises 8% (up to 8 stacks).
A dialogue event where an Orc Mercenary asks to walk in his ancestors' footsteps. Help: the Orc Mercenary who spoke leaves until next dawn and returns with max health permanently up 30% and attack up 20%. Don't help: receive 12G. A codex and record card that does not enter your hand.
오크 주술사가 재로 그려 주는 문양입니다. 용병의 장신구 칸에 끼우면 그: A mark an Orc shaman draws in ash. Fit in a Mercenary's trinket slot and when that Mercenary falls (once per night), foes within 5m are seized with fear and flee for 4 seconds.
꼬챙이에 통째로 굽는 오크식 잔치 요리입니다. 아무 곳에나 놓고 손패의: A whole animal roasted on a spit, Orc-style feast food. Place it anywhere and use 3 raw meat from your hand to fully restore all Mercenaries' health and raise their attack 20% that night.
무리의 냄새가 밴 털 장신구입니다. 용병의 장신구 칸에 끼웁니다. 수인: A fur trinket steeped in the pack's scent. Fit in a Mercenary's trinket slot. Worn by a Beastfolk Mercenary, for each other Beastfolk within 8m, movement and attack speed rise 10% (up to 40%).
짐을 절대 내려놓지 않는 수인 짐꾼의 등짐입니다. 용병의 방어구 칸에 끼: The pack of a Beastfolk porter who never sets a load down. Fit in a Mercenary's armor slot. Carried by a Gatherer or Hunter, the amount picked up doubles, and while carrying a load, movement speed rises 25%.
수인 용병이 겨울잠이 쏟아진다고 털어놓는 대화 이벤트입니다. 재운다: 말: A dialogue event where a Beastfolk Mercenary confesses that hibernation sleepiness is overwhelming him. Put to sleep: the Beastfolk Mercenary who spoke doesn't wake until next dawn, and on returning his max health rises permanently by 40. Wake him: nothing happens. A codex and record card that does not enter your hand.
인간 용병이 아는 이에게 써 주겠다는 소개장 대화 이벤트입니다. 소개장을: A dialogue event where a Human Mercenary offers to write an introduction to someone he knows. Accept the letter: choose a race and the next Guest you can hire comes as that race. Decline: receive 8G. A codex and record card that does not enter your hand.
도장이 찍힌 직업 길드의 증서입니다. 낮에 아무 곳에나 놓고 아직 쓰지: A stamped writ from a trade guild. Place it anywhere by day and choose 1 unused contract card to change that contract's job. The character and race stay the same.
근처 마을에서 달려온 민병들입니다. 밤 전투 중 땅이나 적에게 놓으면 인: Militia who came running from a nearby village. Place it on the ground or a foe during night combat and 2 Human militiamen come, returning to the village at dawn. If within 4m of a Mercenary of another race, they gain half of that race's passive.
인간 용병이 숲에서 찾은 낡은 기록을 내미는 대화 이벤트입니다. 읽는다:: A dialogue event where a Human Mercenary hands over old records he found in the forest. Read: choose 1 of 3 random race cards. Close: remove 1 Blight card from the pouch (6G if none). A codex and record card that does not enter your hand.
길 위의 순례자가 남긴 축복입니다. 아무 곳에나 놓으면 손패의 침식 카드: A blessing left by a pilgrim on the road. Place it anywhere to remove all Blight cards in your hand and brighten the Lodge's reputation by 12.
인간 용병이 아는 상인의 마차가 산장 앞에 서는 대화 이벤트입니다. 마차: A dialogue event where a merchant a Human Mercenary knows pulls a wagon up before the Lodge. Open the wagon: buy 3 cards of other races at 18G each. Let it pass: nothing happens. A codex and record card that does not enter your hand.
드워프의 흑맥주와 오크의 고기를 함께 싼 전투 식량입니다. 아무 곳에나: Field rations wrapping Dwarf dark ale and Orc meat together. Place it anywhere and for that night (until dawn) all Mercenaries' max health rises 40% (without slowing) and they restore 50% health.
드워프·오크 용병이 함께 있을 때의 이야기: Story when Dwarf and Orc Mercenaries are together
묘지와 제단 아래에서 나온 검은 단검입니다. 아무 용병에게나 놓으면 그: A black dagger found beneath the graveyard and the Altar. Place it on any Mercenary to sacrifice them and gain 1 Corpse and 1 of 3 Undead cards. The Lodge's reputation darkens by 15. Using it the first time unlocks Undead cards. Cannot be used on a Mercenary who took a blood oath.
묘지 확장·제단 복구(처음 한 번): Graveyard expansion · Altar restoration (first time only)
쓰러지거나 바쳐진 용병이 남긴 시체입니다. 카드에 그 사람의 이름이 적힙: A corpse left by a fallen or sacrificed Mercenary. The person's name is written on the card. Place it on the ground during night combat to raise 1 Skeleton Soldier, which crumbles at dawn. If unused, it rots away at dawn a day later.
제물의 단검 · 용병이 쓰러짐(언데드가 열린 뒤): Sacrificial Dagger · A Mercenary falls (after Undead unlock)
무덤 흙을 움켜쥐고 부르는 짧은 명령입니다. 밤 전투 중 아무 곳에나 놓: A short command called out with a fistful of grave soil. Place it anywhere during night combat and all Mercenaries who have already fallen or will fall that night rise again as skeletons and fight until dawn.
뼈를 엮어 세운 음산한 방책입니다. 땅에 놓고 손패의 시체 2장을 쓰면: A grim barricade woven from bones. Place it on the ground and use 2 Corpses from your hand to raise a barricade with 120 health. Each time a foe dies within 5m, its health rises by 12.
희미한 빛이 갇힌 봉인된 병입니다. 아무 곳에나 놓고 손패의 시체 1장을: A sealed jar with a faint light trapped inside. Place it anywhere and use 1 Corpse from your hand to draw 2 cards from the pouch.
언데드 아군에게 차려 주는 음산한 만찬입니다. 아무 곳에나 놓으면 손패의: A grim feast laid for Undead allies. Place it anywhere to use every Corpse in your hand, and for each, all Undead allies recover 30% health and gain 15% attack (until dawn).
무덤이 한꺼번에 열리는 행진입니다. 시체가 5장 이상일 때 밤 전투 중: A march in which the graves open all at once. With 5 or more Corpses, place it on the ground during night combat to use all the Corpses you have and raise that many Skeleton Soldiers (up to 12). Appears as a reward candidate only when the Lodge's reputation is 'Infamous'.
뼈만 남은 날랜 사냥개입니다. 밤 전투 중 땅이나 적에게 놓고 손패의 시: Nimble hounds reduced to bone. Place it on the ground or a foe during night combat and use 1 Corpse from your hand to raise 2 Skeleton Hounds, which chase frightened or weak foes first.
산장을 둘러싼 흉흉한 소문입니다. 산장의 소문이 '음산' 이하일 때 새벽: An ominous rumor about the Lodge. It mixes into the pouch at dawn when the Lodge's reputation is 'Gloomy' or lower. It cannot be used, and while in hand, each one raises hiring costs by 8G. Cleansing it brightens the reputation by 5.
소문이 '음산' 이하인 새벽: Dawn when reputation is 'Gloomy' or lower
바친 이들의 이름을 적어 두는 검은 장부입니다. 마녀의 장신구 칸에 끼우: A black ledger recording the names of those sacrificed. Fit in the Witch's trinket slot to count the Mercenaries sacrificed while it is worn. For every 5, choose 1 of 3 Undead cards.
산장을 거쳐 간 종족들의 문장을 한데 기운 깃발입니다. 아무 곳에나 놓으: A banner stitched together from the crests of the races that have passed through the Lodge. Place it anywhere to hang it at the Lodge permanently. With 3 or more Mercenaries of different races, all Mercenaries deal 20% more damage.
공용 용병 이벤트(서로 다른 종족 셋 이상): Shared Mercenary event (three or more different races)
여러 종족의 말을 받아 적어 온 통역사의 깃펜입니다. 마녀의 장신구 칸에: A quill of an interpreter who has taken down the speech of many races. Fit in the Witch's trinket slot to raise the chance of shared events (other-race cards, harmony, neutral) in Mercenary events from 30% to 55%.
서로 다른 종족 용병이 4명 이상일 때만 나오는 대화 이벤트입니다. 축제: A dialogue event that appears only with 4 or more Mercenaries of different races. Hold the festival (20G): all Mercenaries' max health rises permanently by 20 and attack by 10%. Next time: nothing happens. A codex and record card that does not enter your hand.
공용 용병 이벤트(서로 다른 종족 넷 이상): Shared Mercenary event (four or more different races)
지나가던 낯선 손님이 선물을 남기는 대화 이벤트입니다. 받는다: 아직 고: A dialogue event where a passing stranger leaves a gift. Accept: gain 1 card of a race you haven't hired yet. Decline: receive 5G. A codex and record card that does not enter your hand.
용병들이 산장을 한바탕 치우자고 나서는 대화 이벤트입니다. 정리한다: 주: A dialogue event where the Mercenaries step up to give the Lodge a good cleaning. Tidy up: choose 1 card in the pouch and remove it permanently. Leave it: nothing happens. A codex and record card that does not enter your hand.
술에 잔뜩 취한 떠돌이 술꾼 에린이 술병을 쏟아 놓습니다. 아무 곳에나: Erin, a wandering drunk, is dead drunk and spills her bottles. Place it anywhere to receive 3 random cards among Fire Ale, Golden Mead, Wisp Spirit, Dew of Forgetting, and Drunken Rant (the same card may repeat). Drunken Rant comes most often and Golden Mead is the rarest.
에린의 이야기(술 카드 3장 사용 후 찾아옴): Erin's story (she visits after you use 3 drink cards)
목을 타고 불이 넘어가는 독한 에일입니다. 용병에게 놓으면 새벽까지 그: A strong ale that sends fire down the throat. Place it on a Mercenary to raise that Mercenary's attack 40% until dawn, and the first 3 attacks set foes ablaze, damaging them for 3 seconds. For the first 30 seconds of the next day, a hangover keeps them from working.
벌꿀로 빚은 달콤한 금빛 술입니다. 낮에 쓰면 산장에 묵는 손님 한 명을: A sweet golden drink brewed from honey. Used by day, it treats one Guest staying at the Lodge. That Guest pays 50% more for lodging and their goodwill rises one step, and next day they return and leave 1 card of their race as a gift. There is no cost.
푸른 도깨비불이 병 속을 떠다니는 독주입니다. 아무 곳에나 놓은 뒤 손패: A spirit in which a blue will-o'-the-wisp floats in the bottle. Place it anywhere, then choose 1 card in your hand. There is a 50% chance you get one more of that card (the same effect twice), and a 50% chance that card rolls into the pouch. Even on failure, the card is not lost.
새벽 이슬로 담근 맑은 술입니다. 아무 곳에나 놓으면 주머니에서 무작위: A clear drink steeped in dawn dew. Place it anywhere to look at 3 random cards in the pouch and permanently remove 1 of them for this run. Next morning's draw is reduced by 1. Contract cards cannot be removed.
취한 에린이 늘어놓는 횡설수설입니다. 아무 곳에나 놓으면 손패에서 무작위: The incoherent babbling of a drunk Erin. Place it anywhere to shuffle 2 random cards from your hand into the pouch and draw 1 new card from the pouch. It is not a drink, so it doesn't count as a drink card for calling Erin. Its illustration is one of three; with several Drunken Rants you receive different pictures.
